hero.headline: Guiding your digital transformation journey. From strategy to delivery.
hero.subtext: Having led digital transformation at Siemens, I saw first-hand how often initiatives stall — not because the tools are wrong, but because strategy, governance, and architecture aren't in place. Mendix 11 is our primary delivery platform, but the approach works across your entire digital estate.

inflection_point.label: Why now
inflection_point.headline: The window is open — briefly.
inflection_point.body1: Before AI, the argument for low-code was speed — getting apps to production faster than traditional development. That argument is now obsolete. The real question is whether your organisation can build enterprise-grade applications within the right governance and strategic guardrails: moving fast, but scaling safely.
inflection_point.body2: Most organisations are not there yet. Governance is patchy, teams work in silos, no standards exist or are simply not enforced. After a few apps in production, initiatives run into the same walls — not because the technology is not ready, but because the organisational foundation underneath it is not.
inflection_point.body3: Modern platforms are building compliance controls and AI integration in by design. But the platform is secondary. The structural advantage goes to teams that build the right foundation now.
inflection_point.closing: That is the work we do.
inflection_point.footnote: Not sure where your organisation stands? Take the assessment below.

problem.headline: Start is the easy part.
problem.body: Most organisations adopt the right platform. Momentum builds early, then stalls. Complexity accumulates, standards don't exist, and no one can agree on what to prioritise. The platform gets the blame. The real gap is strategic — knowing which problems to solve, and in what order, to unlock the most value.
problem.punchline: We know how to find those problems. And how to build the path forward.

services.label: What we do
services.headline: From first sprint to full CoE. We cover the full transformation lifecycle.
services.item1_desc: You can't improve what you can't measure. We built a custom maturity assessment across six dimensions — platform usage, team capability, governance, architecture, AI readiness, and organisational maturity — scored and delivered as a baseline report with an initial recommendation. Most engagements start here.
services.item1_meta: Delivered as a scored report across 6 dimensions · Typical duration: 2 weeks
services.item2_desc: Preparing your platform for AI-assisted development means more than adopting the latest release. We map your application landscape, identify business logic and custom work, and determine what needs to move, change, or be rebuilt. For Mendix organisations, that means a structured path to Mx11 — where all future agentic capabilities are being built.
services.item3_desc: Hands-on execution that leaves your team capable, not dependent. We work embedded with your team — developing, delivering, and explaining every decision along the way. Whether you need us for a single phase or a long-term extension, the goal is always the same: when we leave, you can run it yourself.
services.partner_note: Mendix partner looking for senior capacity on a complex engagement?
services.item4_desc: Governance doesn't stick when it's only documented — it needs to be built, enforced, and championed at every level. As solution architect at Siemens, I set up governance frameworks, started CoE initiatives, and enforced standards across multiple teams. As transformation manager, I helped programme owners put governance on the agenda and made the case for it when it mattered most. That hands-on experience is what we bring.

That engagement rooted us in the region and shaped how we approach the work.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Common questions.
faq.q1: What does a Maturity Assessment include?
faq.a1: A structured review across six dimensions: platform usage, team capability, governance, architecture, AI readiness, and organisational maturity. The output is a scored report that we discuss together — either right away or in a planned follow-up — to pinpoint the topics worth setting up or improving. It is a collaborative starting point, not a document drop.
faq.a2: Yes. We work worldwide, remote-first. We have delivered for clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, the Netherlands, and beyond. Large timezone differences are manageable — we discuss upfront how to structure communication so it works for both sides.
faq.q3: Can you work alongside our existing team?
faq.a3: Yes. We do hands-on delivery, work alongside your existing developers, or both. Some clients need us to deliver; others need us to coach and guide their team. Most engagements end up being a mix — we adapt to what the situation actually requires.
faq.q4: How are engagements scoped and priced?
faq.a4: We scope and price after an initial conversation. There is no fixed rate card — engagements vary by size, duration, and complexity. We will be direct about what makes sense.
